description: Get metadata for files or directories. Use when you need to check existence, size, or read cost. Do not use for contents; use `read` instead, `list` for directory entries, or `find_files` to find by name. Pass `path` or `paths` (up to 1000), never both. Paths settle independently (missing gives NOT_FOUND); the call errors only if all fail. Symlinks report their own metadata, not the target's. `path` gives one result; `paths` gives one per path, in input order. Returns per-path values or errors ({ code, message }), plus summary { total, succeeded, failed }. Values hold name, path, type, size or entryCount (directories), tokenEstimate (files, bytes/4), timestamps, permissions (POSIX) or readOnly (Windows), isHidden (dot prefix), mimeType, symlinkTarget.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

name: stat
